# Apply to Outtalent by Aug 31st to get a job at a top tech company by 2022


## You pay only if you get a job in one of your target companies


[Ana Ghidelli](https://medium.com/@anaghidelli?source=post_page---byline--86dbcf41021e---------------------------------------)


3 min read


·


Aug 17, 2021


--


Press enter or click to view image in full size


Golden Gate bridge in San Francisco


### Outtalent in a nutshell


We call ourselves “a career accelerator that helps ambitious engineers around the world 10x their career”.


Our online educational program for backend and iOS engineers lasts up to 4 months. It is led by engineers and engineering managers from companies like Google, Facebook, and Stripe. They help you ramp up your knowledge of distributed system design, algorithms, and data structures. In addition to that, the program improves your writing, storytelling, and negotiation skills important for your behavioral interviews, overall communication with employers, and your career after.


You don’t pay before or while you are in the program. You pay only if you get a job in a top 10 company of your choice.


### New batches


We’re happy to announce that applications are now open for Fall 2021! We are looking for engineers for two of our programs: Everest Backend and Everest iOS. To be eligible, engineers must have 2+ years of full-time work experience (or an impressive engineering accomplishment) as well as advanced theoretical knowledge in their domain of expertise (backend or iOS).


### Reasons to apply


We believe anyone can set and achieve ambitious goals by themselves. However, joining Outtalent has lasting impacts — such as friendships with like-minded ambitious engineers — as well as many shorter-term benefits:


1. We help you stay motivated and prepare ~4x faster than you would prepare alone
2. We increase compensation by 20k+ USD on average by synchronizing offers and helping you negotiate well
3. We ensure you get a higher seniority level and avoid downgrades that happen to international candidates
4. We know the depth and the breadth of knowledge you need and help you avoid extra months of preparation
5. We have outstanding mentors from companies you target who give specific, constant feedback


If you want to check out the top 15 reasons for joining Outtalent from our graduates, check out this[article](https://medium.com/outtalent/5-practical-reasons-why-you-should-use-a-career-accelerator-c272df2f7a5d) .


### Our accomplishments


We have been running our career accelerator for the past 2 years and we’ve helped get offers from Amazon, DeepMind, Facebook, Flexport, Google, Microsoft, Reddit, Spotify, Stripe, TikTok, and Uber in Europe, Canada, and the US. Our most popular employer is Google and our most popular destination is London.


Outtalent’s last batch was the strongest yet:


- On average, graduates got 3 offers from one of the top tech companies of their choice, at minimum, they got 2 offers
- Their average base salary reached 115k USD/year (not including stock, relocation packages, or bonuses)
- 100% of graduates got an offer at either Google, Facebook, Amazon, or Microsoft and shared[testimonials](https://outtalent.com/community/index.html)


We also are very proud of the mentorship team that we built. It consists of experienced engineers and engineering managers like[Usman Masood](https://www.linkedin.com/in/umasood/) (Pipe, Stripe, Facebook, Microsoft, MIT),[Dan Silva](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielribeirosilva/) (X, Google, Apple, Amazon, Microsoft),[Nikita Podguzov](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikita-podguzov-43601715a/) (Google), and[Dima Korolev](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dimakorolev/) (Poker Stars, Google, Microsoft).


### Apply now to secure your spot


Our batches consist of only 8 people each, so everyone has the proper attention throughout the program.


Therefore seats are limited and first-come, first-served. Fill out the form at[outtalent.com/check](http://outtalent.com/check) to check your eligibility. It should take ˜2 minutes.


### Got a question?


Send your question to[team@outtalent.com](http://team@outtalent.com/) or reach out on our Admissions Telegram chat ([https://t.me/outtalentadmissions](https://t.me/outtalentadmissions) ).
